IT & Security

Cloud Solutions

Plan, migrate and run workloads on Azure, AWS and Alibaba Cloud with cost and security built in.

Why it matters

Cloud lets you scale up or down, pay for what you use and reach systems from anywhere. Done well it also improves resilience and security.

Without it

Uncontrolled spend, copies of data in places nobody tracks, and migrations that break systems people rely on.

What it does

We assess your applications, choose the right landing zone and migrate with minimal downtime. Identity, governance and monitoring are in place before the first workload moves.

3D flow: how it works

  1. Discover Inventory servers, dependencies and data sensitivity so nothing is migrated blind.
  2. Design Build the landing zone first: identity, network, backup and policy guardrails.
  3. Migrate Move workloads in planned waves (rehost, replatform or refactor), each with a tested rollback.
  4. Operate Patching, backups, audits and monthly cost reviews keep the estate healthy and the bill predictable.

Illustrative flow of a typical setup. Not live customer data.

  • Configure and tune Azure virtual machines and services for performance, availability and compliance
  • Build and maintain hybrid environments linking on-premises systems to the cloud
  • Administer Microsoft 365: provisioning, licensing and secure mailbox configuration
  • Run system audits and impact assessments before and after migration
  • Assess hosting, integration and security needs for enterprise AI agent server workloads

How we deliver it

  1. Discover: inventory servers, dependencies and data sensitivity
  2. Design: landing zone, network, identity and backup
  3. Migrate: rehost, replatform or refactor in planned waves
  4. Operate: patching, audits and performance tuning

Why we specialise in it

Our engineers work hands-on with Azure, AWS, Alibaba Cloud and Microsoft 365 in production environments, including identity, backup and cost control.

Cloud Desktop

Managed desktops, virtual machines and devices so staff work safely from anywhere.

Why it matters

A cloud desktop gives staff the same secure workspace from any device, and IT manages one image instead of hundreds of machines.

Without it

Data on lost laptops, slow onboarding, inconsistent software and long fix times for every device.

What it does

Staff get a consistent, policy-controlled desktop on approved devices while company data stays protected. Access is tied to identity and device compliance.

3D flow: how it works

  1. Sign in The user signs in from any device and proves who they are with multi-factor authentication.
  2. Check the device Device management reports whether the device is enrolled and compliant; the access policy weighs both.
  3. Connect If the policy allows it, the session is brokered to the user’s virtual desktop.
  4. Work Apps and files stay in the cloud, so a lost laptop does not mean lost data.

Illustrative flow of a typical setup. Not live customer data.

What we do

  • Configure Intune MDM: device compliance, restrictions and application management for laptops, desktops, tablets and Android devices
  • Manage Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory: authentication, group policy and user provisioning
  • Administer Hyper-V and VMware ESXi/vSphere: VM provisioning, resource optimization and high availability
  • Roll out endpoint security policies alongside device management

How we deliver it

  1. Profile users, applications and devices
  2. Build images and virtual machines on Hyper-V, VMware or Azure
  3. Enrol devices and enforce policy with Intune
  4. Apply identity and access rules and monitor compliance

We run Intune, Entra ID and virtual desktop platforms day to day and design the identity and device policies around them.

Network Solutions

Firewalls, VPN, wireless and identity-based network access control.

Why it matters

Every application depends on the network. Good design means speed, segmentation and the ability to see and control traffic.

Without it

Flat networks where one infected machine reaches everything, slow links and outages that are hard to trace.

What it does

We design segmented networks and firewalls that follow least privilege. Who and what connects is decided by identity and device posture, not just a password.

3D flow: how it works

  1. Connect A device plugs in or joins Wi-Fi and the switch asks it to authenticate (802.1X).
  2. Decide Network access control checks who the user is and whether the device is compliant.
  3. Segment Known, healthy devices get the right VLAN; unknown or failing devices are sent to quarantine.
  4. Protect Traffic to the internet and cloud passes the firewall with inspection and logging.

Illustrative flow of a typical setup. Not live customer data.

What we do

  • FortiGate and Forcepoint NGFW policy administration: rules, VIPs, port forwarding, traffic inspection and perimeter defense
  • VLANs, routing, DNS and DHCP design and support
  • VPN for secure, encrypted remote user authentication
  • ClearPass NAC deployment and monitoring for identity-based access
  • Event log and traffic analysis, network troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
  • Cisco, Aruba and UniFi equipment

How we deliver it

  1. Assess: topology, traffic and risks
  2. Design: segmentation, firewall policy, VPN and access control
  3. Deploy: configure, test and document
  4. Audit: log review and rule clean-up

Why we specialise in it

We configure and operate FortiGate, Check Point, Forcepoint NGFW and ClearPass access control, and we build our own network monitoring product, Net-Monit.

Disaster Recovery

Backup, storage and tested recovery using Veeam, Acronis, Quorum, HPE 3PAR and NetApp.

Why it matters

Disasters, ransomware and simple mistakes happen. Recovery only works if the targets are agreed and the restore has been proven.

Without it

Backups that fail when needed, days of downtime and data that cannot be recovered.

What it does

We set recovery targets (RPO and RTO) with you, then match tooling to them. Recovery is tested on a schedule so the plan is proven before it is needed.

3D flow: how it works

  1. Normal service Users reach the primary site through the traffic manager.
  2. Replicate Data is copied to the DR site at an interval set by your recovery point objective (RPO).
  3. Detect failure Health checks fail and the traffic manager marks the primary site as down.
  4. Fail over Traffic is redirected to the DR systems running on the replica, within your recovery time objective (RTO).

Illustrative flow of a typical setup. Not live customer data.

What we do

  • Configure, manage and monitor Veeam, Quorum, HPE 3PAR and MSA storage for backup integrity and DR readiness
  • Plan and run storage migrations, including to NetApp
  • Acronis backup for Microsoft 365: mailboxes, OneDrive and SharePoint
  • Oracle RMAN backup operations for consistent, recoverable databases
  • NAS-based backups with retention policies and recovery procedures
  • Backup success monitoring and recovery-time improvement

How we deliver it

  1. Business impact analysis and recovery targets
  2. Design: multiple copies including an offline or immutable one
  3. Implement: backup jobs, replication and runbooks
  4. Test: scheduled restore and failover drills

Why we specialise in it

We configure and test Veeam, Quorum, Acronis and enterprise storage (HPE 3PAR, NetApp) and plan recovery against agreed RPO and RTO targets.

Cyber Security

Data loss prevention, XDR/EDR, email security, privileged access and vulnerability management.

Why it matters

Attackers target people, endpoints, email and identities. Layered controls and fast detection limit the damage of any single failure.

Without it

Data leaks, account takeover and incidents found weeks late with no evidence to investigate.

What it does

We layer prevention and detection: data, endpoints, email, identity and privileged accounts are each protected, and alerts feed an investigation and response process.

3D flow: how it works

  1. Prevent Email filtering, firewall rules and patching stop most attacks at the edge.
  2. Contain Endpoint protection blocks or isolates whatever gets past the edge.
  3. Protect data Data loss prevention stops sensitive files leaving by email, web upload or USB.
  4. Detect and respond Signals from every layer are correlated in one place and a person acts on them.

Illustrative flow of a typical setup. Not live customer data.

What we do

  • Forcepoint DLP policies across endpoints: data classification, flow analysis and incident handling
  • Taegis XDR, Sophos MDR, SentinelOne and Kaspersky EDR: policy creation, access restrictions and automated response
  • Microsoft Defender and Check Point email security against phishing, malware and spam
  • Azure Information Protection: sensitivity labels and auto-labeling rules
  • BeyondTrust Password Safe: privileged access policies, credential rotation and audit
  • Review regulator and audit findings and track remediation to closure
  • CVSS-based vulnerability management and system hardening

How we deliver it

  1. Assess: risk review, configuration and identity audit
  2. Protect: DLP, endpoint, email and privileged access controls
  3. Detect: XDR, EDR and managed detection and response
  4. Respond: containment, root-cause analysis and remediation tracking

Why we specialise in it

Our core work is security operations: DLP, XDR and EDR, email security, privileged access and vulnerability management on real enterprise estates.
